requirements.content_instructions: Uploaded candidate photograph; format: JPEG; file size: 50-100 KB; dimensions: 320 x 240 px; 100 dpi; background: white or light colour; face coverage: at least 50%; recency: within 60 days.
rejection_conditions: Non-frontal or side-facing pose can fail the stated requirement.
Eyes must be visible/open as stated.
Spectacle glare, dark or coloured glasses can make the photograph unacceptable.
Caps/hats are restricted; any permitted religious covering must leave required facial features visible.

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: CEN No. 08/2024 - Level 1 Posts - Mandatory scanned documents (https://wcr.indianrailways.gov.in/uploads/files/1771596254046-CEN_%2008_2024_English.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: CEN No. 08/2024 - Level 1 Posts - Mandatory scanned documents (https://wcr.indianrailways.gov.in/uploads/files/1771596254046-CEN_%2008_2024_English.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.dimensions.width_px.reasoning: The body publishes the pixel figure landscape while giving a portrait physical size in the same sentence, and the two agree in magnitude but not orientation. Recorded upright, because an examination photograph is a head-and-shoulders portrait and no body in the researched set requires a landscape one. The published figure is preserved verbatim in permitted_pixel_range so the transposition is visible.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
